0.0: Are you going to join? Are you going to become a Guard? Oh, great! Now, since you're a little young, you can't be a full Guard, but I'll treat you the same as an official Guard.
0.1: Now, onto your first assignment! It's pretty simple. Clean up the path that leads to the Mushroom Castle by eliminating the #o2110200#s surrounding the Henesys Mushroom Forest. If it's too difficult, just tell me. Want to give it a try?

yes.0: Wow, you accept without hesitation! Great! Go on and eliminate #r50 #o2110200#s#k!

no.0: Well, it's okay if it's too hard. Let me think of something easier. Hmm... But this is a basic job that all Guards should be able to do...

1.0: Wow, you eliminated 50 #o2110200#s already? I was right about you. I thought you would do a good job. And oh, here's something I forgot to give you earlier.

yes.0: Here, this is the Honorary Guard Medal. It's not much, but it should come in useful. I'll call when I have a new assignment for you.

mob.0: You haven't eliminated #r50 #o2110200#s#k yet? Hmm... Maybe you're not as strong as #p1040000# said. Is it because you're not used to this place?
